app.name: FocusTogether
app.tagline: Calm, steady focus — one session at a time.

setup.title: Almost there
setup.body: Firebase isn't configured yet. Copy .env.example to .env, fill in your Firebase web app keys, then restart the dev server.

login.title: Welcome
login.subtitle: Sign in to keep your focus sessions in one place.
login.error: Couldn't sign in. Please try again.

completedMessages: You gave this your full attention, and that matters.
Steady effort, one session at a time. Well done.
Take a breath — you've earned it.
earlyMessages: Every minute counts, and these minutes are yours. Thank you for showing up.
Stopping when you need to is part of working well. Be proud of the time you gave.
Whatever you did here is progress. Rest, then come back whenever you like.

history.title: History
history.emptyBody: Start your first one whenever you're ready. Every minute counts.
history.loadError: Couldn't load your history. Please try again in a moment.

notify.title: Time's up — nice work
notify.body: {{task}} · {{n}} min of focus. Take a breath.

settings.title: Settings
settings.soundHelp: A soft two-note chime. Never an alarm. Stopping early is always silent.
settings.notifyHelp: A quiet message, only if this tab is in the background.
settings.notifyDenied: Notifications are blocked for this site. Allow them in your browser settings to use this.
settings.hideDigitsHelp: Just watch the shape shrink. During a session, tap the timer to show or hide the numbers.
settings.chimeHint: Can't hear it? Check that your device volume is up and this browser tab isn't muted.
settings.chimeBlocked: The browser didn't let the sound play. Tap the button again, and check that this tab isn't muted.
settings.chimeUnsupported: This browser can't play sounds from web pages.
settings.showJourneyHelp: A small line map under the timer when you are on a journey.

journey.title: Choose a journey
journey.intro: Cross a region of Thailand with your focus time. Totally optional — change or leave any time.
journey.cardEmptyBody: Optional: cross a region of Thailand with your focus time.
journey.currentNote: Choosing a new one ends this journey where the train is. Your minutes stay in your history.
journey.goalHeading: How much focus to cross it?
journey.speed: The train covers about {{km}} km for every focus minute.
journey.error: Couldn't start the journey. Please try again.
journey.toNext: About {{n}} min of focus to the next stop
journey.endOnItsWay: The train is on its way.
journey.endArrivedBody: You crossed {{region}}. Rest here, or choose another journey whenever you like.

music.title: Focus music
music.help: Optional. Paste a YouTube video or playlist link and a small player appears on the Focus screen. It never starts by itself. On desktop Chrome or Edge you can pop it out into a floating window.
music.label: YouTube link
music.invalid: That doesn't look like a YouTube video or playlist link.
music.ok_video: Video found. It will show on the Focus screen.
music.ok_playlist: Playlist found. It will show on the Focus screen.
music.note: YouTube may show ads depending on your account, and the player has to stay visible. Music needs internet and stops when you leave the Focus screen. The floating window only works in desktop Chrome and Edge, and closes if you close this tab.
music.tapPlay: Tap play in the player when you're ready.
music.mix_ignored: This is a YouTube Mix, which can't be embedded, so only this one video will play. For continuous music, use a playlist link or a long lo-fi stream.
music.poppedOut: Playing in the floating window. Closing it brings the player back here.
music.popHint: Pop out shows the video and timer in a small window that stays on top of other apps and tabs. The song restarts when it moves.
